meta.climatology: 1991-2020 monthly mean (anom = value - climatology for that calendar month)
meta.data_type: reanalysis / observation (no model predictions in this file)

era5_sst.title: Sea-surface temperature (open ocean, 50-60S band excluded from Antarctic mean)

era5_wind10.title: 10 m wind: magnitude of the monthly-mean wind vector
era5_wind10.note: Speed of the monthly-mean vector, not the monthly mean of instantaneous speed (lower in variable winds).

era5_sea_ice_extent.title: Sea-ice extent (concentration >= 15 %)
era5_sea_ice_extent.source: ERA5 monthly sea-ice cover (OSI SAF-based boundary condition)

merra2_t2m.title: 2 m air temperature
merra2_t2m.source: NASA MERRA-2 M2TMNXSLV monthly means (GES DISC)

merra2_slp.title: Sea-level pressure
merra2_slp.source: NASA MERRA-2 M2TMNXSLV monthly means (GES DISC)

osisaf_sea_ice_extent.title: Sea-ice extent (concentration >= 15 %), monthly mean of daily values
osisaf_sea_ice_extent.note: Days with missing data beyond the land/pole mask are excluded; months with fewer than 15 valid days are omitted (early SMMR record is every other day).
osisaf_sea_ice_extent.source: EUMETSAT OSI SAF OSI-450 CDR + OSI-430 ICDR via Copernicus Marine (C1)

glorys_sea_ice_thickness.title: Mean sea-ice thickness over ice-covered cells (concentration >= 15 %)
glorys_sea_ice_thickness.source: Mercator GLORYS12 reanalysis (model) via Copernicus Marine (C2)

ifremer_drift_speed.title: Mean sea-ice drift speed (monthly mean of daily speeds, ice-covered cells)
ifremer_drift_speed.source: IFREMER AMSR-E/AMSR2 3-day sea-ice drift via Copernicus Marine (C5)

multiobs_sst.title: Near-surface ocean temperature, Southern Ocean mean
multiobs_sst.source: Copernicus Marine MULTIOBS observation-based T/S reconstruction (C7)

multiobs_mld.title: Ocean mixed-layer depth, Southern Ocean mean
multiobs_mld.source: Copernicus Marine MULTIOBS observation-based T/S reconstruction (C7)
